title: Qualitative Research in Education, Health and Society
description: Examines issues surrounding the development of research representations that inform issues in education, health and society. A core component of the course is to develop, gather data and report on a community-based inquiry project. Qualitative genres based on different modes of inquiry are explored and applied in a student developed inquiry project.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EPHE 585, EPHE 480 (if taken in the same topic), PE 585.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
